title: Best Habit Tracker App out there
body: I’ve gone Reddit post to Reddit post, tried every app I possibly could. Some have a confusing layout, most force in app purchase. This allows upto 6 habits. I absolutely love it and am so grateful to the creator everyday I use it. Idk who you are but thank you so much this helped my life a lot. I’ve been using it for around 2 years now. I’m just waiting for the day I save up enough money to buy the lifetime plan. Please don’t remove the lifetime option! Most apps force monthly or annual subscription. This one allows a lifetime purchase and that’s a wayyyy better option. I’m just waiting to save up enough money to buy it. Thank you <3
